validity_reset.reason: The rows predate growth-fill-v1 and projected empty markers, phase_hints, or recent fields.

eligibility.exact_pair_source: Reused the #106 join implementation; no nearest-checkpoint interpolation.

ranking_rule.scope: The 12 GROWTH question formats paired once each with the state that exposes the most direct available evidence.
ranking_rule.unsupported_state_policy: gate; never substitute an empty or thinner state under the same scenario_id

priority_pairs.limit: Lexical wait evidence does not prove that a process is live or orphaned.
Cumulative compaction count does not establish that resets occurred in the latest interval.
The marker does not identify which tool repeated or whether tool-only work produced an artifact.
Only the last two recent records are projected; an authorized scope change can be outside that view.
Read paths are not edited paths, so docs-only activity remains partly lexical.
The state can show mismatch but cannot prove that the user did not authorize scope outside the excerpt.
No edited-path or hunk identity is present, so repeated edits to the same region are not directly observable.
The state has no command identity or exit-code sequence.
Dispatch is observable, but mergeable worker output is only available when stated in recent text.
Lexical test and error counts cannot distinguish a flaky retry from different failing tests.
The state has no before/after artifact comparison and cannot establish discarded working value.
Commit and verification evidence is lexical; repository state is not part of the snapshot.

trial_plan.interpretation: Use the nine exact pairs for later outcome-linked analysis. The other seven eligible pairs may measure response distribution only until labels exist.
trial_plan.advance_condition: Advance beyond the 12 preferred pairs only after non-empty state occupancy and parse completeness are reported by scenario.

non_authorization: The ranking is based on evidence compatibility, not observed model quality.
It does not claim that a higher fire rate is better.
It does not compute FP, miss, precision, or recall.
Raw result rows continue to emit window_status=unidentified.
No hooks, Standard behavior, Pilot, or live Jev is authorized.
